step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an event processing and data lake architecture. Internal applications send event data to Kinesis Firehose, which stores raw files in an S3 bucket. A CloudWatch Event triggers AWS Step Functions, invoking Lambda functions to split and index data. Processed data is saved into a central S3 bucket and indexed in OpenSearch (Elasticsearch). Athena queries the S3 data lake, Airflow manages ETL workflows to Redshift, and QuickSight provides BI dashboards.
